definitions.true_positive: Triage judged the reported claim to be real; decision validity is confirmed.
definitions.hardening: Historical triage verdict for a real defense-in-depth weakness.
definitions.undetermined: Triage did not reach a validity answer; requires review.
definitions.false_positive: Triage judged the reported claim to be wrong.
definitions.duplicate: The report duplicates an existing finding; it does not create a validity decision.

standard.none: Project-defined classifier vocabulary; existing meanings are retained.

hardening.note: Finding kind is separate from validity. true_positive remains the triage verdict.
